invariants.rationale: toMap always returns a non-null Map.
data.stream() is called unguarded, so data must not be null.
func is passed to throwingMapToPairWrapper, so must not be null.
Each key in the result is derived from an element in data (with possible key collisions), so result cannot have more entries than data.
parallelism is used as an unguarded argument, so it must not be null.
